# Do You Know

> Free quizzes for children and grown-ups in the UK: a daily challenge, friend battles and KS1 to GCSE school-subject practice. Every answer comes with a short explanation, and many link to a source. No ads, no trackers, no sign-up for players.

Answers are only shown after a player answers, so quiz questions and answers are not published as pages.

## Main pages

- [Home](https://doyouknow.space/): all subjects and today's challenge
- [How to play](https://doyouknow.space/how-to-play): question types, practice and ranked play, fair scoring
- [Today's challenge](https://doyouknow.space/daily): one quiz a day, the same for everyone
- [Leaderboards](https://doyouknow.space/leaderboards)
- [About](https://doyouknow.space/about): what the app is and how it treats children's privacy
- [Privacy notice](https://doyouknow.space/privacy)

## Subjects and quizzes

- [Sitemap](https://doyouknow.space/sitemap.xml): every subject page (/c/...) and quiz page (/q/...)
